name: dependency-update
description: Safely update project dependencies. Checks for breaking changes, runs tests before and after update, and generates a change report with risk assessment.

inputs.name: package
inputs.description: Specific package to update. If omitted, updates all outdated packages.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Update report: packagesUpdated, packagesSkipped, breakingChanges, testsPassedBefore, testsPassedAfter.

failureConditions.signal: test suite fails after dependency update
updated package has a major version bump
npm install exits with lockfile conflict
